Chat request that includes a developer role message alongside user messages

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a coding assistant. Always respond with concise code examples.\",\"role\":\"developer\"},{\"content\":\"How do I reverse a string in Python?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    println(result)
}

```
